properties.description:
Review acceptance timed out at 60 seconds in earlier complete browser runs with 62 changed files. The UI sent one approval operation per file before acceptance. Preserve current-check, fingerprint, approved-content and all-file requirements.

The authored 62-file before-run accepted successfully but required 63 operations and about 35 seconds; its exact operation-count recording differed from the intended two. This reproduced the scaling problem, not the historical timeout itself. Historical full-run failures remain in .harness/review-acceptance-full-failure-20261024/ and splitter-full-browser-results.json.

Replaced the singular owner operation with session:review-files. It holds the session lock, validates the fingerprint and every requested path before changing any approval, hashes current contents and emits one batch event. All consumers use the batch contract; the predecessor operation was removed. Acceptance independently enforces current checks and complete approvals.

The identical 62-file browser input now uses exactly two operations and passes through commit: about one second focused and about 1.3 seconds for batch approval plus acceptance in run-PMHhAv. All 27 focused owner tests pass, including atomic validation, stale fingerprints, withdrawn approvals and multiple repositories. The rendered review/history screenshot was inspected.

Evidence: HarnessApp/test-results/review-62-before-v2-20261025/, review-62-after-20261025/ and .harness/review-owner-after-20261025.log.

Completed in 5838e11. Final checkpoint .harness/checkpoints/run-RPaAAX/report.json passed in 38.34 minutes: 676 model/unit/tooling tests, 331 browser tests, zero failures and zero native crashes. Type, organisation, boundary and build checks passed. Source hashes remained unchanged throughout verification. Completion receipt: .harness/queued-work-completion-20261025.json. Changes are committed on codex/queued-work; the worktree is clean and the managed app is running on Node 24.22.1. The final 62-file case recorded exactly two requests and 1,294.91 ms combined approval/acceptance time.
properties.title: Bug: Review acceptance times out with accumulated changed files
